diagnostic_workflow:
name: P8 Mac supervisor diagnostic

on: [create]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
  DIAG_SOURCE: a23bb72d3c954f385b99fe81ce9189885c208557

jobs:
  source_admission:
    if: github.event.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.ref == 'task/p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic-a217-20261009'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify all fixed product and validation inputs with the unchanged v15 implementation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/mac-source-admission"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mac-source-admission/execution-head.txt"
          set +e
          python3 -B scripts/verify_reviewed_source_v15.py --source-version p8-completion-source-20261009-v15 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mac-source-admission/stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/mac-source-admission/stderr.log"
          result=$?
          set -e
          echo "$result" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mac-source-admission/exit-code.txt"
          exit "$result"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mac-diagnostic-source-admission-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mac-source-admission
          if-no-files-found: error

  diagnose:
    needs: source_admission
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: admission
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: a23bb72d3c954f385b99fe81ce9189885c208557
          path: source-e
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
      - name: Bind the two reviewed diagnostic sources and execute one observation pair
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path("admission/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic-20261009")
          expected = {
              "observer.rs": "b0f4c7c3b2aa9454b147bdc9ac36eebe6c08cec881d34b26d3784e04c01c3533",
              "run_diagnostic.py": "be25d30eae5a3b59837b87845d9969867aa366a8453068fea6ce90cdad8b8455",
          }
          for name, digest in expected.items():
              path = root / name
              assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
              assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
          PY
          python3 -B admission/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic-20261009/run_diagnostic.py --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/source-e" --observer "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/admission/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic-20261009/observer.rs" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic" --execution-sha "${{ github.sha }}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: mac-supervisor-diagnostic-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/p8-mac-supervisor-diagnostic
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

## 文档约定
- 文档语言为简体中文；代码标识符、命令、日志、错误信息保留原文。
`docs/benchmarks/` 下的报告由测试生成（英文），不手工编辑。
文档的 schema/表数/工具数/关键默认值由
[P8-FACTS](roadmap/code-index-v2/P8-FACTS.md) 生成并检查。
这些是本地工程能力和验证入口；完整 release profile、holdout、100k、受控尾延迟、
真实 provider 收益及 G8 需各自当前候选证据。普通 baseline 或 comparison 的退出码 0
不能自动提升为发行认证。下方 legacy 观测、目标值和历史性能结论保持各自原测量范围。
[八格平台执行](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37871838952)
覆盖 Linux/macOS × Rust 1.95.0/stable × default/semantic：每格使用新 target，
执行 release 产品构建和 stdio smoke。这证明受测组合的构建与所执行协议；
原回执没有记录 macOS SDK 版本，不能据此认证任意 SDK，也不等于 workspace
回归、安装/卸载或完整发行验证。
同一源码在 macOS 26.6.2、Rust 1.95.0、SDK 15.4 的

[原 workspace 执行](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/7d5402a17cfdd06274e8204ec544bd4db104f872/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-a23-closeout-20261009-bfcc/round6-reviewed-engineering/review-ci/premerge-workspace/attempt02-sdk154/execution-receipt.json)
保留 exit 101；`subprocess_descendant_cannot_hold_stderr_past_worker_deadline`
失败后的原 binary 单项执行也失败。这是未闭合的工程回归，不能由冷构建成功抵消。
[后续 hosted macOS 15 诊断](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37892853323)
使用未修改的该源码，仅运行原单项测试和独立 observer；工作流状态成功，原 artifact
尚待独立复核。它不代表 macOS 26.6.2 或完整 workspace 已通过，也不回写旧失败。
准备好 helper 后的测试与首次执行新 helper 的测试应分别记录前置条件；二者的通过
不能互换。当前平台范围和未完成项仍由各固定源码的原件与任务台账决定。
## P2-D：连续变更、独立真值与成本

`cc-eval mutation-case --case <case.json> --output <新目录> --shrink-attempts 32` 可独立重放十四表增量/全量对照，并以手写关系谓词检查两条路径共同出错的盲区；有效失败保留原件并自动缩减阶段，错误输入不冒充产品反例。动态接口 Unknown、未闭合阶段和 reducer 自测分别报告。SQL 工作量、名称桶/墓碑增长、1k/5k release 机制成本与公开 MCP 回归口径见 [INCREMENTAL_VERIFICATION.md](internals/INCREMENTAL_VERIFICATION.md)；不据此认证 100k、尾延迟或语义 holdout。
